root_cause.text: blk_mq_[un]quiesce_tagset() incorrectly acquired the mutex set->tag_list_lock while iterating the tag_list, creating a circular lock dependency where a timeout handler holding that lock cannot complete queue quiesce, while a queue removal path holding the same lock waits for a queue freeze that depends on the timeout handler's completion.
root_cause.evidence: The patch description explicitly states that using set->tag_list_lock in blk_mq_quiesce_tagset() results in deadlock between nvme_timeout (which calls blk_mq_quiesce_tagset) and blk_mq_exit_queue (which calls blk_mq_update_tag_set_shared under the same lock). The two stack traces show one thread blocked on set->tag_list_lock (top) and another holding it while waiting for blk_mq_freeze_queue_wait (bottom). The fix replaces the mutex with RCU read-side protection for the list traversal.

candidates.rationale: Acquires set->tag_list_lock in blk_mq_quiesce_tagset, causing a circular lock dependency with timeout handlers that also hold this lock while attempting to quiesce.
Iterates the tag list under the mutex, keeping the lock held during the loop and preventing any other context from completing operations that require this lock.
Releases the lock only after the entire iteration, which delays the lock release and contributes to the deadlock window.
Similar lock acquisition in blk_mq_unquiesce_tagset, creating the same lock ordering problem as the quiesce variant.
Holds the mutex while iterating the tag list in the unquiesce path, preventing other lock holders from making progress.
Delayed unlock after iteration in unquiesce, extending the time the lock is held and exacerbating the circular dependency.
Lock acquisition in queue removal path that, when combined with the quiesce/unquiesce lock, creates a deadlock cycle: removal waits for freeze, freeze waits for timeout, timeout waits for this lock.
Performs list deletion under the mutex in the removal path, contributing to the lock hold time and the circular dependency.
Releases the lock after removal operations; the lock was held during removal, forming part of the deadlock chain.
Adds to the tag list under the mutex in the add path, which also holds the lock and can contribute to the deadlock if concurrent with quiesce/unquiesce.
Unlock in the add path; the lock acquisition (not shown in hunk) combined with this unlock creates another site where the lock is held, participating in the circular dependency.
